context: Hi there! I hear you're looking for a recommendation for a movie?
yeah, i'm looking for something cyberpunk
what's your favorite cyberpunk movie?
blade runner, but i don't like the remake
gotcha. What do you think the remake got wrong?
it seemed like the pacing ignored that main guy's progression into doubt
absolutely. Did you watch Akira? What was your opinion on it if you did
i loved it
Awesome, me too! Do you prefer vintage cyberpunk or are you looking for newer movies/and/or remakes?
im looking for something newer right now
thanks! did you see ready player one?
ya i did
what did you think of it?
i think it sucked and i feel like i  wasted my time with it
for sure. It was really mixed reviews for that one. Have you heard of Anon? It's a film on Netflix
no, sounds like an interesting name!

It definitely slid under the radar and I'd be interested to hear your thoughts on it! The premise is about a world with the non-existence of privacy and anonymity. Every person has an implant that records their every move, and their life and records can be accessed anytime through 'The Ether.' I'd be interested to hear your thoughts on it
i think that sounds interesting and privacy, in the area of data sales, is more topical
it is definitely an interesting idea. It got mixed reviews so I'd be interested to hear your opinion on it. Do you accept my recommendation?
ya, thanks a lot
